paragraphs: Rav Eina the elder, to Rav Naḥman. In Ḥullin, where Rabbah says to remove his amora, it is unqualified Rav Eina, not Rav Eina the elder; see preceding entry. He understood the unqualified one as the elder, thus omitted a separate unqualified Rav Eina. He objected to Rav Naḥman, who, in one version, called him 'black pot' (see his entry), Megillah 14b; Pesaḥim 88a.
